lines.zh: 我走向村庄，走了三天。
lines.en: I walk toward the village, three days now.

lines.zh: 我记得这条路的每一块石头。
lines.en: I remember every stone on this road.

lines.zh: 我的鞋磨穿了，脚还在走。
lines.en: My shoes wore through; the feet keep walking.

lines.zh: 我绕过自家的菜地，不敢看。
lines.en: I skirt my own garden and dare not look.

lines.zh: 草鞋声和拖步声，一前一后。
lines.en: Straw sandals and dragging steps, one then the other.

lines.zh: 我沿着水渠走，尝过那水。
lines.en: I follow the ditch; I have tasted that water.

lines.zh: 有人的脚步声，我的腿就快了。
lines.en: When footsteps sound, my legs speed up.

lines.zh: 我经过教堂，停了一小会儿。
lines.en: I pass the church and pause a little while.

lines.zh: 这身袍子是从前穿的，还合身。
lines.en: This robe was mine before, and it still fits.

lines.zh: 我怕走进村子，也怕走不进去。
lines.en: I fear entering the village, and fear not entering.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊一直举着，放不下来。
lines.en: My arms stay raised; I cannot lower them.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在我从前的位置上。
lines.en: Every step lands where I used to walk.

lines.zh: 我站在门口，抬手想敲门。
lines.en: I stand at the door, a hand raised to knock.

lines.zh: 橱窗里的面包，我已经不饿了。
lines.en: The bread in the window; I am not hungry now.

lines.zh: 我记得金苹果的味道，很酸。
lines.en: I remember the golden apple tasting sour.

lines.zh: 药水瓶碎了，汁还在我袖口。
lines.en: The potion bottle broke; its juice stains my cuff.

lines.zh: 我试着说出自己的名字，说不清。
lines.en: I try to say my own name and fail.

lines.zh: 教堂的钟敲了七下，我数得清。
lines.en: The church bell rings seven; I count them all.

lines.zh: 身边没人，可我觉得有人排队。
lines.en: No one is here, yet I feel a queue behind me.

lines.zh: 我低头看手，指甲又长了。
lines.en: I look at my hands; the nails grew again.

lines.zh: 这个村子有一半是我的回忆。
lines.en: Half this village is made of my memories.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，喉咙还是有咕噜声。
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet a grunt stays in my throat.

lines.zh: 我认得你这身衣服的料子。
lines.en: I recognize the cloth of that coat.

lines.zh: 你看我的样子，和我从前一样。
lines.en: You look at me the way I once looked at you.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，皮肤是灰的。
lines.en: I lift my face; the skin is grey.

lines.zh: 你手里有虚弱药水吗？
lines.en: Do you carry a potion of weakness?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很亮，那不是灯。
lines.en: My eyes are bright, and that is not lamplight.

lines.zh: 你后退的这一步，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that one step you took backward.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，先叫了一声你的名字。
lines.en: I open my mouth and your name comes out first.

lines.zh: 我们从前在同一个市集上买盐。
lines.en: We once bought salt at the same market.

lines.zh: 你还没认出我，对吧。
lines.en: You have not recognized me yet, have you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你看，记起你爱还价。
lines.en: I stare and recall how you love to haggle.

lines.zh: 剑伤不深，我的皮很厚。
lines.en: The cut is shallow; my hide is thick.

lines.zh: 你砍在肩甲上，只留一道白痕。
lines.en: You strike my shoulder plate and leave a white mark.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起药水泼下来的那晚。
lines.en: The pain recalls the night the potion was poured.

lines.zh: 我退开，先把袍子上的血擦掉。
lines.en: I step back and wipe the blood off my robe.

lines.zh: 血是黑的，落在地上却发红。
lines.en: My blood is black, yet it reddens on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我说不出话。
lines.en: This blow leaves me without speech.

lines.zh: 我捂着胸口，指缝里漏出咕噜。
lines.en: I clutch my chest; a grunt leaks through my fingers.

lines.zh: 你的武器很沉，我站住了。
lines.en: Your weapon is heavy, and I stay standing.

lines.zh: 伤口在太阳下冒烟，我忍着。
lines.en: The wound smokes in sunlight; I endure it.

lines.zh: 别打了，我想把话说完。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I want to finish my sentence.

lines.zh: 你手里的金苹果，我认得。
lines.en: The golden apple in your hand, I know it.

lines.zh: 虚弱药水别泼，我自己喝。
lines.en: Do not splash the weakness potion; let me drink it.

lines.zh: 面包的味道，让我想起工作台。
lines.en: Bread smells like my old workbench.

lines.zh: 你带绿宝石来了？真新鲜。
lines.en: You brought emeralds? How novel.

lines.zh: 我伸手，想接过那只苹果。
lines.en: I reach out to take that apple.

lines.zh: 腐肉很咸，我还是想吃面包。
lines.en: Rotten flesh is salty; I still want bread.

lines.zh: 你手一松，我就往前挪半步。
lines.en: The moment you loosen your grip, I inch forward.

lines.zh: 我记得交易的手势，还记得。
lines.en: I still remember the trading gesture.

lines.zh: 这个价钱太贵，我却点了头。
lines.en: The price is absurd, yet I nodded.

lines.zh: 别喂我，我会咬到你的手。
lines.en: Do not hand-feed me; I may bite your hand.

lines.zh: 撞到我，先闻到腐肉和面粉味。
lines.en: Bump me and smell rot mixed with flour.

lines.zh: 我的肩比普通僵尸更沉。
lines.en: My shoulder is heavier than a common zombie's.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You crash into me and I do not budge.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我认人很慢。
lines.en: Not so close; I recognize people slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬手，本意是想扶你。
lines.en: I raise a hand meaning to steady you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在门框上，门掉了。
lines.en: We hit the door frame and the door falls.

lines.zh: 我身上有旧伤，别碰左侧。
lines.en: I have an old wound; avoid my left side.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就不追这一回。
lines.en: Step back and I will not follow this time.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你手上会留灰印。
lines.en: One touch leaves a grey print on your hand.

lines.zh: 我推门很轻，推人就不一定。
lines.en: I push doors gently; people, not so much.

lines.zh: 我曾经有个妻子，在磨坊那边。
lines.en: I had a wife once, over by the mill.

lines.zh: 她一定听说我死了。
lines.en: She must have heard that I died.

lines.zh: 别让我去见她，这张脸不行。
lines.en: Do not send me to her; this face will not do.

lines.zh: 我们的婚戒还在她手上。
lines.en: Our wedding ring is still on her hand.

lines.zh: 那间屋子里曾有两个人。
lines.en: Two people once lived in that house.

lines.zh: 她会在门口等到天黑。
lines.en: She will wait at the door until dark.

lines.zh: 我连一句完整的话都说不出。
lines.en: I cannot manage one whole sentence.

lines.zh: 让她当我没回来过。
lines.en: Let her think I never came back.

lines.zh: 我记得她怕打雷，会捂耳朵。
lines.en: I recall she feared thunder and covered her ears.

lines.zh: 这些事，不该由一个死人提。
lines.en: A dead man should not bring these things up.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚绿宝石，手停在半空。
lines.en: I pick up an emerald and my hand freezes.

lines.zh: 那袋面粉，我也想背回去。
lines.en: I want to carry that sack of flour home too.

lines.zh: 我捡起锄头，握法还是熟的。
lines.en: I pick up a hoe; the grip still feels right.

lines.zh: 铁片硌手，我换另一只。
lines.en: The iron shard stings; I use the other hand.

lines.zh: 你把面包丢下，我接住了。
lines.en: You drop the bread and I catch it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，袍子下摆拖进泥里。
lines.en: I bend, and my hem drags through the mud.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西，我都想还回去。
lines.en: Whatever I pick up, I want to return it.

lines.zh: 那把刀我拿反了，还拿着。
lines.en: I hold the knife backward and keep holding it.

lines.zh: 掉落的声音，比人声更清楚。
lines.en: A dropped thing sounds clearer than a voice.

lines.zh: 我把绿宝石放进原来那只口袋。
lines.en: I put the emerald in its old pocket.

lines.zh: 我先闻到面粉味，才看见你。
lines.en: I smell flour before I see you.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块砖，我铺过。
lines.en: I laid the brick you just stepped on.

lines.zh: 记忆里你的脸，和眼前对上了。
lines.en: The face in my memory matches the one here.

lines.zh: 我认出了你，所以不能放你走。
lines.en: I know who you are, so I cannot let you go.

lines.zh: 那条声音说：就是这个人。
lines.en: The voice says: this is the one.

lines.zh: 我的手抬起来，比脑子快。
lines.en: My hand rises faster than my mind.

lines.zh: 村里的旧路，我闭眼也能追。
lines.en: I could chase you blind on these old roads.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在反光，很亮。
lines.en: The thing in your hand glints, very bright.

lines.zh: 四十步不算远，我走惯了。
lines.en: Forty paces is nothing; I am used to walking.

lines.zh: 我站直了，这不太像原来的我。
lines.en: I straighten up, and that is not like me.

lines.zh: 你退向市集，那里人更多。
lines.en: You back toward the market, where more people are.

lines.zh: 我喉咙响了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: My throat clicks once, as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你被我记住了，这不好。
lines.en: You have been remembered by me; that is bad.

lines.zh: 别喊救命，喊了我也会应。
lines.en: Do not cry for help; I will answer too.

lines.zh: 你在村口站住，我就跟上了。
lines.en: You paused at the village gate. I followed.

lines.zh: 我跟着你穿过市集，撞翻摊位。
lines.en: I chase you through the market, knocking stalls over.

lines.zh: 你转弯，我记得那条巷子。
lines.en: You turn; I remember that alley.

lines.zh: 我走得比普通僵尸村民快。
lines.en: I move faster than a common zombie villager.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在石板上，很响。
lines.en: Your steps ring loud on the stone slabs.

lines.zh: 我从菜园穿过去，踩坏两垄。
lines.en: I cut through the garden, ruining two rows.

lines.zh: 那扇门你没关严，我推开了。
lines.en: You left the door ajar; I pushed it open.

lines.zh: 我一路不说话，怕它听出来。
lines.en: I stay silent on the way, lest it notice.

lines.zh: 你在井边停下，我也停下。
lines.en: You stop at the well, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我追你，不全是我自己的意思。
lines.en: Chasing you is not entirely my own idea.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，比我快。
lines.en: Your shadow on the wall moves faster than me.

lines.zh: 我绕过钟楼，那边人少。
lines.en: I go around the bell tower, where fewer people are.

lines.zh: 台阶很高，我一步一步上。
lines.en: The steps are high; I climb them one by one.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，方向越清楚。
lines.en: The harder you pant, the clearer your direction.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头是磨坊，没出口。
lines.en: This road ends at the mill, with no way out.

lines.zh: 我踩过菜地，鞋上全是泥。
lines.en: I cross the garden, boots heavy with mud.

lines.zh: 你躲进铁匠铺，我从后门进。
lines.en: You hide in the smithy. I come through the back.

lines.zh: 那声音一直在我耳朵里数你的步。
lines.en: That voice keeps counting your steps in my ear.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙走，怕自己撞倒灯。
lines.en: I steady myself on walls so I do not knock over lamps.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你肩上，你听见裂声。
lines.en: My fist meets your shoulder; you hear it crack.

lines.zh: 我抓你的时候，手势像在数钱。
lines.en: When I grab you, my hand counts coins.

lines.zh: 你挡了，盾边硌进我的指缝。
lines.en: You block; your shield edge digs into my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我力气大得不像我自己。
lines.en: This strength is not like mine at all.

lines.zh: 我抬手又停下，只差半寸。
lines.en: I raise my hand and stop, half an inch short.

lines.zh: 你退后，我跟着撞上门板。
lines.en: You back away; I slam into the door plank.

lines.zh: 这一击带着市集上的火气。
lines.en: This blow carries the market's bad temper.

lines.zh: 我指甲里有面粉，也有血。
lines.en: There is flour under my nails, and blood too.

lines.zh: 我打你一下，就往后退半步。
lines.en: After one blow I step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我的袍子破了口子。
lines.en: You cut me; my robe opens at the seam.

lines.zh: 别让我抓住手腕，挣不开的。
lines.en: Do not let me catch your wrist; it will not free.

lines.zh: 我听见自己喘气，可我不需要。
lines.en: I hear myself panting, though I need no air.

lines.zh: 打完，我会站在原地道歉。
lines.en: Afterward I will stand there and apologize.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我的手垂了下来。
lines.en: When you fall, my hand finally drops.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的袖子，布料先烂了。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve, and the cloth gives first.

lines.zh: 这一拳落下，我听见自己骨头响。
lines.en: The punch lands, and I hear my own bones creak.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽边缘走来，袍子湿透。
lines.en: I come from the swamp edge, robe soaked through.

lines.zh: 村里少了一户人家，灯没亮。
lines.en: One household fewer; its lamp stays dark.

lines.zh: 我站在教堂门口，没有进去。
lines.en: I stand at the church door and do not enter.

lines.zh: 金苹果和药水都没救回我。
lines.en: Neither golden apple nor potion saved me.

lines.zh: 你听见咕噜声时，我已在你身后。
lines.en: When you hear the grunt, I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先想起的是市集的日子。
lines.en: I open my eyes and recall market days first.

lines.zh: 泥土沾在袍角，洗不掉了。
lines.en: Mud clings to my hem and will not wash off.

lines.zh: 天黑了，这里的门都上了闩。
lines.en: Night falls; every door here is bolted.

lines.zh: 我不是刚变成这样的。
lines.en: I did not turn into this just now.

lines.zh: 有人把土盖在我身上，又揭开。
lines.en: Someone covered me with soil, then uncovered me.

lines.zh: 我朝村口走，脚步自己认得路。
lines.en: I head for the gate; my feet know the way.

lines.zh: 先别点灯，让我习惯一下。
lines.en: Do not light the lamp yet; let me adjust.

lines.zh: 你屋里的味道，和我家一样。
lines.en: The smell of your house is like mine.

lines.zh: 我从菜园那头过来，身上有泥。
lines.en: I come from the garden side, covered in mud.

lines.zh: 火一上身，腐肉的味道更重了。
lines.en: Fire touches me and the rot smells stronger.

lines.zh: 摔下台阶，我的膝盖反着弯。
lines.en: I fall down the steps; my knee bends backward.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我还记得怎么游。
lines.en: Water pours in; I still remember how to swim.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀进菜园，土都是热的。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the garden; the soil is hot.

lines.zh: 箭穿过袍子，钉在背后的木门上。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my robe into the door behind.

lines.zh: 药水的气味又来了，我往后缩。
lines.en: That potion smell again; I shrink back.

lines.zh: 饿到极点，我也吃不下腐肉。
lines.en: Even starving, I cannot eat rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我的骨头照得透亮。
lines.en: Lightning falls and my bones shine through.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有村庄，也没有钟声。
lines.en: No village in the void, and no bell.
